description: Owner decision 2026-11-05 approved a standing rubric so envelope tuning no longer needs owner interrupts. Implement it: (1) pin every Docker image used by UAT to a digest (docker/**/docker-compose*.y*ml and any image referenced by tests/uat), with a check that rejects floating tags such as singlestoredb-dev:latest; (2) a cell failing only with an infrastructure signature (timeout at the cell limit, OOM or per-cell memory cap, download error, SingleStore error 1712) gets exactly one automatic retry inside the same shard, recorded in the evidence and gate summary; the gate passes only if the retry passes; no retry starts when the shard's remaining job time is below the cell limit (the skipped retry is recorded); (3) a script that reads trunk UAT history and reports cells whose infrastructure-failure rate exceeds 20% over their last 10 runs, with a ready-to-apply envelope entry when another scale of the same platform x benchmark stays gated; (4) b2, gate by signal: a per-cell signal record (cell -> defect classes ever caught, product vs infrastructure) generated from history, and a proposed drop list for cells whose only failures were infrastructure, which goes to the owner. Filed rubric items use the title prefix `UAT envelope:` and include `uat-rubric` in links, so rv2r-11 can count them. Product-signature failures (wrong results, validation failures, crashes) are never retried or pruned. Rollback: revert this member's commits; pins can be reverted per image.
